premises.text: Busy people face piled household chores and the mental load of coordinating multiple on-demand services themselves
premises.evidence_span: all of that takes time and coordination and the mental energy. Dan doesn't want to give it

premises.text: For about $99 a month, a dedicated neighborhood Alfred visits weekly on set days and handles automatic household chores
premises.evidence_span: For $99 a month, Dan can get his very own Alfred that visits once a week, every week, on set days to take care of his household chores

premises.text: Alfred is a service layer that anticipates needs and coordinates across on-demand and local verticals with a real person
premises.evidence_span: Alfred is actually a service layer. It sits on top of other on-demand and local services

premises.text: Vetted neighborhood Alfreds plus building partnerships create weekly route economies of scale and overnight neighborhood rollout
premises.evidence_span: we partner with buildings, which allows us to turn on neighborhoods overnight, making us scalable

premises.text: Working parents, busy professionals, and similar households in large cities already spend heavily on home services Alfred can serve
premises.evidence_span: Working parents Busy professionals, road warriors, and all of us can be like Dan, too, and get our very own Alfred

value.text: Busy people get time back through seamless automatic household service
value.evidence_span: we are going to give you back the most precious resource you have, your time

secondary_value.text: Well-paid local work for neighborhood Alfreds
secondary_value.evidence_span: Alfreds are vetted members of your community who enjoy well-paid work that they are proud of helping their neighbors
